note: Editorial and operating defaults (Step 01.3). Proposed values stay provisional until the product owner accepts them; an accepted item records accepted_on and accepted_by. Open items have no value yet. Loaded into configuration at Step 03.

display_timezone.note: Stored in UTC; shown in IST

roles.note: One person may hold several roles

seeded_users.note: Names, emails and role assignments to come from the product owner

recurring_opinion_threshold.note: Independent origin clusters before an opinion is described as recurring; not a fact check

freshness_warning_days.note: Console warns when the active revision is older than this and newer eligible evidence exists

withdrawal_serving_sla_minutes.note: From confirmed withdrawal to serving gate disabled and page revalidated

correction_owner.note: Named person who owns public correction requests

demo_environment.note: Developer machine or shared VM for the Docker Compose demo
